Alex: Hey team - quick design review request. I'm seeing confusion in the bulk retention editor modal + the KMS indicator next to datasets. Also ran into an accessibility oddity with the region selector for screen readers. Want to iterate before the next release. :wave:
Maria: Thanks Alex. Can you list the main pain points you saw? Screenshots would help but short bullets work too.
Alex: Sure - three items:
1) Bulk retention modal: when you apply a retention to multiple datasets we show a red warning line that says "This will change X items." People think it's an error, not a confirmation.
2) KMS indicator: small key icon uses green color only when BYOK is set, neutral gray otherwise — unclear when encryption is customer-managed vs platform-managed.
3) Region selector: VoiceOver reads the expandable list as "selected" even when it's placeholder. Users can't tell which region is currently applied to a dataset group.
Jordan: For (1) we can switch the warning color to an amber confirmation tone, and add a heading like "Confirm bulk update". That should reduce perceived-error signals.
Maria: Agreed. Also tweak copy to be explicit about scope: e.g. "You're changing retention for 12 datasets in 3 projects." vs current "This will change X items." Small change, big clarity.
Alex: Exactly. Proposed modal copy (first pass):
```
Heading: Confirm bulk retention update
Body: You're updating retention from 90 days to 365 days for 12 datasets across 3 projects. These changes are irreversible and will affect export retention and audit logs.
Primary button: Apply changes
Secondary button: Cancel
Inline checkbox: Notify dataset owners by email (recommended)
```
Maria: Nice. For the irreversible line, can we soften it a bit for legal? Maybe "These updates will take effect immediately and cannot be undone via the UI."
Jordan: Works for me.
Sam (a11y): On region selector: we should set `aria-selected` only for an actually selected region and use `aria-label="Region: <name> (current)"` for the currently applied option. Also add `role="listbox"` + `aria-live="polite"` for changes when switching via keyboard.
Alex: Good call. Also a problem in our current impl: placeholder option reads as "US (default) selected" when no explicit selection exists. That confuses users who think default is pinned to resources.
Maria: Maybe show a subtle chip next to placeholder that says "Inherited" and SR reads "Inherited region: US".
Sam (a11y): "Inherited" chip should have `aria-hidden="false"` and be focusable for screen readers. Don't hide it visually.
Sean (QA): I'll add regression tests for VoiceOver and NVDA flows. Also will validate color contrast for the amber confirmation state.
ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: New build deployed to staging at 1988001280. Run your tests and mark PRs when green.
Alex: Thanks Sean. One more KMS idea: instead of color-only state for the key icon, add a two-state tooltip: "Encryption: Redwood-managed" vs "Encryption: Customer KMS (BYOK)" and a small text label for non-dense views.
Maria: I like the tooltip + microcopy approach. For dense tables we keep an icon but add `aria-label` that reads the state. For expanded details view we show the full text.
Jordan: Backend note: we already have the KMS flag per dataset. Exposing it in UI should be low lift. I'll add a small API change to include kms_provider and kms_key_alias in the list response.
Alex: Perfect. Can someone drop a quick mock or Figma link? I'll compile these into a single PR description.
Maria: Figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/bulk-retention-kms-a11y -> frame "bulk-retention-v2" (comments open). Please annotate if copy needs legal review.
Steph: Legal check: change "irreversible" -> "cannot be reversed via the Console" is okay. Also remove explicit mention of "audit logs" to avoid implying log retention guarantees.
Alex: Noted. Updated copy suggestion: "These updates take effect immediately and cannot be reversed via the Console." Remove audit logs line.
Maria: I'll push a copy update and a color token for amber `--color-alert-confirm` to tokens figma.
Jordan: I'll schedule the API change and add a small feature flag so we can rollout the KMS label progressively.
Sean: QA checklist:
- color for confirm state >= AA contrast
- screenreader reads region state correctly in listbox
- tooltip content for KMS present and localized
- bulk modal copy matches legal-approved string
I'll mark as blocked until tests pass. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll open the PR with these changes by EOD and assign to @maria and @jordan for review. :thumbsup:
Maria: No objections. I'll review the PR today.
